refused_originals.target: dydy hynna ddim yn golygu nad ydan ni ddim yn barod

To mean 'already' (the taught sense), it would have to follow a verb-noun, as in 'nad ydan ni ddim yn gwybod yn barod'. So the line uses the LEGO in a different sense, and as an open-ended 'already' fragment it is malformed.
